summary: This bill amends 46 U.S.C. 70022 to bar from U.S. ports any vessel that has transited a port, harbor, or marine terminal in a Western Hemisphere FTA country that was nationalized or expropriated from a U.S. person (or accessible only via U.S.-owned land), unless the President removes the designation after compensation or resolution, or the transit was an emergency.
